## Code Review

This pull request updates the Windows Hyper-V runner configuration, documentation, and validation scripts to use a new golden image SHA-256 hash and corrects the runner's bootstrap entrypoint to use the official `run.sh` script instead of the internal `Runner.Listener` binary. Feedback highlights two main issues: first, when transitioning to the `gha-runner` user in `cie-runner-bootstrap.sh`, environment variables like `HOME` should be explicitly set to prevent permission issues; second, the newly read bootstrap script in `validate-bundle.mjs` should be added to the `requiredFiles` array to avoid unhandled exceptions if the file is missing.
